result.brief: Two-storey steel-framed office block for Lekki Gardens Holdings in Lekki, Lagos, with lifts, central chiller HVAC and full electrical fit-out. Frame is wide-flange steel columns and beams with bar joists supporting profiled metal deck and lightweight concrete topping to upper floor; substructure is strip footings with concrete foundation walls and ground slab. External walls are metal stud with plywood sheathing, plasterboard lining and facing brickwork, with fixed glazed windows and flush doors throughout. Model comprises architecture, structure and electrical only, with no documents, no roof covering, no finishes to floors and walls, and almost no plumbing and drainage information.
